name: opencode-zen-chat-provider
description: Provides OpenCode Zen models to VS Code's Language Model API.

enumDescriptions: Sign in with OpenCode Console device OAuth (no API key needed).
Use an OpenCode Zen API key; the extension prompts securely when needed.
Sign out and clear stored credentials.
authMethod.description: How this model group authenticates to OpenCode Zen.

apiKey.title: OpenCode Zen API Key
apiKey.description: Managed by the extension when authMethod is apiKey; not prompted by Add Models. Use authMethod 'signOut' to clear it.

lane.description: Which OpenCode inference lane to expose. 'auto' includes both.

commands.title: OpenCode Zen: Revert Agents Window Support

opencodeZen.agentsWindow.description: Register OpenCode Zen models in the Copilot Agents window model picker.

opencodeZen.autoEnableAgentsWindow.description: Automatically enable the VS Code settings required for OpenCode Zen models in the Agents window.

opencodeZen.showAgentModelsInManagePanel.description: Show the OpenCode Zen (Agents) vendor in the Language Models management editor.

opencodeZen.modelCacheTtlMinutes.description: How long to cache model metadata before refetching. 0 disables caching.

opencodeZen.transport.enabled.description: Run the extension-owned Bun-compatible HTTP transport and route inference through it.

opencodeZen.transport.binaryPath.description: Optional absolute path to a locally built zen-transport executable. Overrides the bundled helper.

opencodeZen.promptCaching.enabled.description: Enable prompt caching hints for supported providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenAI-compatible).

opencodeZen.promptCaching.retention.description: Retention policy for OpenAI prompt caching. '24h' requires a compatible OpenAI model.

opencodeZen.promptCaching.cacheKeyScope.description: Scope for the prompt cache key used by OpenAI/OpenAI-compatible providers.

opencodeZen.promptCaching.anthropicTtl.description: Anthropic cache_control TTL for cached message blocks. 'none' omits TTL.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run build:gateway
scripts.test:parity: npm run compile && npm run build:gateway && node --test test/*.test.mjs
